node.title: Re^5: Devel::Peek Dump() not printing out
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ultranerds],

I wrote about calling external programs at length [id://1180578|here] (unfortunately not in regards to UTF-8 though), and in fact that thread is about calling [man://curl] as well.

However, personally I would not call an external command at all. Have you tried using [mod://LWP::UserAgent], [mod://LWP::Simple], or [mod://HTTP::Tiny]?

Regards,
-- Hauke D
